item.title: Julia Toolchain in 2026: Juliaup vs Pkg.jl vs Revise.jl — Stop Restarting Your REPL
item.description: Julia’s dirty secret is not performance — it is that most people evaluate the language with the worst possible toolchain. They install one version system-wide from a distribution package, edit code in one window, and then restart a REPL that takes forty seconds to re-load their packages. Every iteration costs a minute, so they conclude Julia is slow to work in.
